body: 3:4竖版展览海报，冷灰背景。中心是一个磨砂玻璃流体瓶形雕塑，渐变冰蓝到浅紫，软箱灯和彩色柔影。只放一个简体中文标题“流体之间”，大字与形体部分重叠，遮挡处虚化，其余文字清晰。留白充分，无其他文字、标志或水印。

en.title: Frosted fluid exhibition poster
en.description: Blue-violet frosted glass sculpture on cool gray. The title 流体之间 overlaps the vessel, with the covered letters deliberately blurred as requested.

## How to use

Copy the exact prompt used for this image. Changing the subject creates a new, untested variant. This example uses no reference image.

## Observed result

Blue-violet frosted glass sculpture on cool gray. The title 流体之间 overlaps the vessel, with the covered letters deliberately blurred as requested.

## Source

Independently adapted from the supplied design prompt collection, case 21. [Source](https://github.com/jamez-bondos/awesome-gpt4o-images/blob/main/README_en.md#case-9-minimalist-futurist-poster). GPT Image returned no precise version identifier.
